title: I finished my WWII interactive fiction trilogy about a village medic in occupied Belarus. Part III is out today
author: PaskaLRaskaL
selftext:
Hi all,

I made a text adventure called **Swamps**, and the last part of the trilogy **is now** on the App Store.

It is a story about Mikhas, a village medic (feldsher) in occupied Polesia, in what is now Belarus. He has no weapon, only the ability to heal and a lot of people who knock on his window at night. The tone is closer to Vasil Bykaŭ than to any action movie: nobody is a hero, there are no right answers, and every choice costs something.

How the trilogy runs:

• Part I (1941): the occupation arrives. Five chapters, free, no ads.

• Part II (1942–43): the blockade. A second playable character, Rezo, joins the story.

• Part III, "Our Own" (winter 1943 to summer 1944): the front moves west, the region burns, and everything you decided before comes due.

A few things about Part III:

• It is the longest part, with more than 600 scenes and nine chapters.

• Your decisions from Parts I and II carry over: who is alive, where your family is, what people take you for, what you paid.

• The branches split far enough that some playthroughs never meet.

• Almost every scene has its own illustration, painted in one style.

• It works offline.

I made all of it on my own, so any feedback helps a lot, including the harsh kind.

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swamps-iii-our-own/id6826629198](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swamps-iii-our-own/id6826629198)

Website: [https://bahna.app](https://bahna.app)

Happy to answer questions about the writing, the Ink engine behind it, or the history.
